facts.text: The authors use manual alignments provided by the RWTH German-English dataset as hard (gold-standard) word alignments for their attention/alignment comparison.
facts.source_quote: For this purpose, we use manual alignments provided by RWTH German-English dataset as the hard alignments.

facts.text: The two attention systems (non-recurrent and input-feeding) were trained on the WMT15 German-to-English training data.
facts.source_quote: We train both of the systems on the WMT15 German-to-English training data, see Table TABREF18 for some statistics.
